items.markdown:
`Yes, durian is highly nutritious and good for you, provided it is eaten in moderation` . It is packed with vitamin C, B-complex vitamins, potassium, dietary fiber, and heart-healthy monounsaturated fats. It also contains antioxidants that help fight inflammation and support immune function.[](https://www.raffleshealth.com/health-articles/durians-good-bad/) [[1]](https://www.raffleshealth.com/health-articles/durians-good-bad/)[[2]](https://e.vnexpress.net/news/life/wellness/7-unexpected-benefits-of-durians-4853103.html)[[3]](https://www.vibhavadi.com/en/blogs/8-ways-to-eat-durian-safely-without-harming-your-health)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TXbOcXtEmgs)[[5]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DBmPp0Jx_4D/?hl=en)[[6]](https://drwillcole.com/durian-fruit-benefits/)

However, durian is calorie-dense and high in natural sugars and carbohydrates, meaning overconsumption can quickly lead to weight gain. The [Healthline Durian Fruit Guide](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/durian-fruit) outlines its exact macronutrient profile. People with diabetes, high blood pressure, or chronic kidney issues should consult a doctor or limit their intake strictly.[](https://www.vibhavadi.com/en/blogs/8-ways-to-eat-durian-safely-without-harming-your-health) 

Additionally, you should completely avoid combining durian with alcohol, as its sulfur compounds can interfere with alcohol metabolism and cause severe indigestion and dangerous reactions.[](https://www.medparkhospital.com/en-US/lifestyles/durian) [[1]](https://www.medparkhospital.com/en-US/lifestyles/durian)
